newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Nov 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Nov 12.

text.p: The Washington Post carries the following stories on its front page:

WASHINGTON - The developer of Silver Spring's proposed $585 million American Dream mall has lined up no private financing only two days before Montgomery County officials must decide whether the project has enough financial backing to proceed.

WASHINGTON - Texaco Inc. said a new analysis of a controversial tape recording shows that its officials did not use racial epithets in discussing a race discrimination lawsuit but conceded that the tone and context were still wrong.

TOKYO - Four days after his re-election, Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto called for a broad deregulation of the nation's financial markets, saying he wants to lift Japan's economy by making it operate more like the free marketplaces of Europe and America.
DETROIT - If America's bold experiment with welfare reform is going to succeed, recipients are going to have to persevere in finding a job.

ANDREWS, Texas - A Texas high school cheerleader, born with cerebral palsy and confined to a wheelchair, was abruptly kicked off the squad this year for "safety reasons" and her mother is fighting back.
